named_reactions.name: Suzuki-Miyaura Cross-Coupling
named_reactions.kinetics: First-order in aryl halide and Pd catalyst; RDS is oxidative addition (for chlorides) or transmetalation (for hindered boronic acids).
named_reactions.stereochemistry: Strict retention of stereochemistry at alkenyl carbons (E/Z geometry preserved).

mechanism_steps.name: Oxidative Addition
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Thermodynamic formation of strong palladium-carbon coordination bonds.

mechanism_steps.name: Base Activation & Transmetalation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: High oxophilicity of boron driving stable borate salt formation.

mechanism_steps.name: Reductive Elimination
mechanism_steps.intermediate: Biaryl product + regenerated active Pd(0) catalyst
mechanism_steps.driving_force: High thermodynamic stability of new C(sp2)-C(sp2) sigma bond.

named_reactions.name: Buchwald-Hartwig Amination
named_reactions.kinetics: Dependent on amine nucleophilicity and phosphine bite angle.
named_reactions.stereochemistry: Ring configuration preserved; inversion/retention depends on chiral amine center.

mechanism_steps.name: Oxidative Addition
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Formation of Ar-Pd(II) coordination intermediate.

mechanism_steps.name: Amine Coordination & Deprotonation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Irreversible salt precipitation (NaX or t-BuOH release).

mechanism_steps.name: Reductive Elimination
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Thermodynamic bond strength of C(sp2)-N (bond energy ~305 kJ/mol).

named_reactions.name: Swern Oxidation
named_reactions.kinetics: Rapid at -78°C; completely avoids overoxidation to carboxylic acids.

mechanism_steps.name: Chlorosulfonium Ion Generation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Irreversible thermodynamic generation of CO2 and CO gases.

mechanism_steps.name: Alkoxydimethylsulfonium Intermediate Formation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Displacement of chloride leaving group.

mechanism_steps.name: Ylide Formation & Intramolecular Hydride Transfer
mechanism_steps.electron_source: Triethylamine abstracts proton from S-methyl group
mechanism_steps.electron_sink: Alkoxy alpha C-H proton via 5-membered cyclic transition state
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Release of stable volatile dimethyl sulfide and C=O formation.

named_reactions.name: Diels-Alder [4+2] Cycloaddition
named_reactions.stereochemistry: Stereospecific syn-addition; Alder endo rule dominates under kinetic control.

mechanism_steps.name: Concerted [4s + 2s] Suprafacial Overlap
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Conversion of two high-energy pi bonds into two thermodynamically stable sigma bonds.

named_reactions.name: Base-Catalyzed Aldol Condensation
named_reactions.kinetics: Second-order; dependent on enolate formation rate.

mechanism_steps.name: Enolate Generation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: pKa equilibration (alpha-H pKa 16-20).

mechanism_steps.name: Nucleophilic Addition
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Nucleophilic attack on polarized carbonyl dipole.

mechanism_steps.name: E1cB Elimination (Dehydration)
mechanism_steps.electron_sink: Beta C-O sigma* orbital expelling OH-
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Extended pi-system conjugation stabilization.

named_reactions.name: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution: Nitration
named_reactions.stereochemistry: Planar aromatic ring; preserves ring configuration.

mechanism_steps.name: Nitronium Ion Generation
mechanism_steps.electron_sink: Dehydration of H2NO3+ generating linear O=N+=O
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Superacid dehydration thermodynamics.

mechanism_steps.name: Arenium Ion Formation (RDS)
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Electrophilic attack (rate-limiting loss of aromaticity).

mechanism_steps.name: Rearomatization
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Restoration of 152 kJ/mol aromatic stabilization energy.

mechanism_steps.name: Concerted Backside Displacement
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Bond formation thermodynamics and leaving group stability.

named_reactions.name: Unimolecular Nucleophilic Substitution (SN1)
named_reactions.stereochemistry: Racemization with slight inversion bias due to intimate ion-pairing.

mechanism_steps.name: Heterolytic C-LG Cleavage (RDS)
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Solvent dielectric stabilization and hyperconjugation.

mechanism_steps.name: Nucleophilic Capture
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Lewis acid-base coordination.

mechanism_steps.name: Deprotonation
mechanism_steps.driving_force: Proton transfer to solvent pool.

protecting_groups.name: Boc (tert-Butyloxycarbonyl)
protecting_groups.stability: Stable to bases, reducing agents, catalytic hydrogenation; acid-labile

protecting_groups.name: Fmoc (9-Fluorenylmethoxycarbonyl)
protecting_groups.stability: Stable to strong acids; base-labile (E1cB mechanism)

protecting_groups.name: TBS / TBDMS (tert-Butyldimethylsilyl)
protecting_groups.stability: Stable to organometallics and mild oxidants; fluoride-labile

protecting_groups.name: Acetal / 1,3-Dioxolane
protecting_groups.cleavage_conditions: Aqueous 1M HCl / Acetone or PPTS / wet acetone
protecting_groups.stability: Inert to bases, nucleophiles, and hydrides; acid-labile
